<div id='av_section_1' class='avia-section main_color avia-section-default avia-no-border-styling avia-bg-style-scroll  avia-builder-el-1  el_after_av_fullscreen  el_before_av_section    container_wrap fullsize' style=' '   style=' ' ><div class='container' ><div class='template-page content  av-content-full alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-11'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'>
<div class="flex_column av_one_full  flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding first  avia-builder-el-2  el_before_av_one_full  avia-builder-el-first  welcome-to-vela-baja " style='border-radius:0px; '><div style='padding-bottom:10px; ' class='av-special-heading av-special-heading-h1  blockquote modern-quote modern-centered  avia-builder-el-3  el_before_av_textblock  avia-builder-el-first   '><h1 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >Vela Baja: Watersports in Mexico since 1988</h1><div class='special-heading-border'><div class='special-heading-inner-border' ></div></div></div>
<section class="av_textblock_section "  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock  '  style='font-size:16px; '  itemprop="text" ><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Open 7 days a week each winter from November 15 to March 15</strong></p>
</div></section>
<section class="av_textblock_section "  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock  '  style='font-size:15px; '  itemprop="text" ><p>Vela Baja offers lessons, rentals and guided tours for a range of activities including <a href="https://velabaja.com/kiteboarding-rentals-lessons-in-los-barriles/">kiteboarding</a>, <a href="https://velabaja.com/windsurfing-rentals-lessons-in-los-barriles/">windsurfing</a>, <a href="https://velabaja.com/wingfoiling-lessons-rentals-in-los-barriles/">wingfoiling</a>, <a href="https://velabaja.com/bike/">biking</a>, and <a href="https://velabaja.com/sup/">stand-up paddling</a>.</p>
<p>You&#8217;ll find us at Hotel Playa Del Sol in Los Barriles which is on the East Cape of Baja California Sur about an hours drive from San Jose Del Cabo&#8217;s international airport.</p>
<p>Want a complete vacation package? We can book hotel accommodation and airport transfers as well as your activity rentals and lessons.</p>
</div></section>
<section class="av_textblock_section "  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock  '  style='font-size:15px; '  itemprop="text" ><p><span class="av_font_icon avia_animate_when_visible avia-icon-animate  av-icon-style-  avia-icon-pos-left " style="color:#f05a1a; border-color:#f05a1a;"><span class='av-icon-char' style='font-size:40px;line-height:40px;' aria-hidden='true' data-av_icon='' data-av_iconfont='entypo-fontello' ></span></span>“Extended Stay Special Offer &#8211; <strong>Up to 50% off</strong> standard rates for long term accommodation or equipment rentals. Click <a href="https://velabaja.com/extended-stay/">here</a> for more info</p>
</div></section></div><div class="flex_column av_one_full  flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding first  avia-builder-el-8  el_after_av_one_full  el_before_av_one_full  column-top-margin" style='border-radius:0px; '><div style='padding-bottom:25px; ' class='av-special-heading av-special-heading-h3  blockquote modern-quote modern-centered  avia-builder-el-9  el_before_av_masonry_gallery  avia-builder-el-no-sibling   '><h3 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >Choose your activity</h3><div class='special-heading-border'><div class='special-heading-inner-border' ></div></div></div>
